body:
## Pull request overview

This PR adds comprehensive GitHub automation workflows and improves existing CI/CD infrastructure for the Object UI repository. The changes establish automated processes for security scanning, dependency management, issue/PR lifecycle management, and enhanced continuous integration.

**Changes:**
- Added 8 new GitHub workflow files for automated processes (CodeQL security scanning, Dependabot auto-merge, stale issue management, PR auto-labeling, bundle size checks, secret scanning, and changelog generation)
- Enhanced existing CI workflow with improved pnpm caching and Codecov token support
- Added complete issue/PR template system with bug reports, feature requests, and PR guidelines
- Created comprehensive workflow documentation and configuration files

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 19 out of 19 changed files in this pull request and generated 6 comments.

| ---- | ----------- |

| CONTRIBUTING.md | Added detailed documentation about automated workflows and contributor tips |
| .github/workflows/stale.yml | Automated stale issue/PR management with configurable timeframes |
| .github/workflows/size-check.yml | Bundle size monitoring and PR comment reporting |
| .github/workflows/secret-scan.yml | Gitleaks integration for secret detection |
| .github/workflows/labeler.yml | Automatic PR labeling based on changed files |
| .github/workflows/dependabot-auto-merge.yml | Automated approval and merging of Dependabot updates |

| .github/workflows/ci.yml | Enhanced CI with pnpm store caching and Codecov token |
| .github/workflows/changelog.yml | Automated CHANGELOG.md generation on releases |

| .github/dependabot.yml | Dependabot configuration for npm and GitHub Actions updates |

| .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md | Standardized PR template with checklist and metadata |

| .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/config.yml | Issue template configuration with external links |
| .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug_report.md | Structured bug report template |
</details>

The stat command syntax varies between BSD (macOS) and GNU (Linux) systems. While the fallback chain is correct, this workflow runs on ubuntu-latest, so the BSD syntax `-f%z` will always fail first. Consider reordering to try the GNU syntax first for efficiency, or simply use the GNU syntax since the workflow explicitly targets Ubuntu.
```suggestion
                  size=$(stat -c%s "$file" 2>/dev/null || echo "0")
```

The condition `[ ! -f "${file}.map" ]` checks for the non-existence of a `.map` file, but the constructed filename is incorrect. If `$file` is `dist/bundle.js`, this checks for `dist/bundle.js.map`, not `dist/bundle.map`. Use `[ ! -f "${file%.js}.js.map" ]` or adjust the logic to correctly identify source map files.
```suggestion
                if [ -f "$file" ] && [ ! -f "${file%.js}.js.map" ]; then
```

The URL hardcodes the organization name as `objectstack-ai`, but the README and other files reference `objectql/objectui`. This inconsistency will cause broken issue links in the generated changelog. Verify the correct organization name and update accordingly.
```suggestion
    { pattern = '\((\w+\s)?#([0-9]+)\)', replace = "([#${2}](https://github.com/objectql/objectui/issues/${2}))"},
```

Similar to the cliff.toml issue, this URL references `objectstack-ai` organization, but other parts of the codebase suggest the repository might be under a different organization. Verify the correct GitHub organization and repository path.
```suggestion
    url: https://github.com/objectql/objectui/discussions/categories/ideas
```

The badge URLs in the example use `objectstack-ai` as the organization, which may not match the actual repository organization. Ensure these example URLs reflect the correct GitHub organization path to avoid confusion when contributors copy them.
```suggestion
[![CI](https://github.com/objectql/objectui/workflows/CI/badge.svg)](https://github.com/objectql/objectui/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![CodeQL](https://github.com/objectql/objectui/workflows/CodeQL%20Security%20Scan/badge.svg)](https://github.com/objectql/objectui/actions/workflows/codeql.yml)
```
